body: Fact (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-19 13:10Z, corrected by Sol-license #691). TermAl's maintained full gate (scripts/test-launcher.mjs requiredStages, lines 183-210) runs cargo-check, typescript, fingerprint-tests, rust-tests (scripts/test-rust.sh) and vitest. It has NO clippy -D warnings stage; Engram's gate does (fmt, check, clippy, rust, rust-scale-*…). A rustc warning in TermAl code does not fail TermAl's gate. It's still owned cleanup, because CLAUDE.md asks for `cargo check` clean. Don't claim a TermAl gate will fail at clippy.
